args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in production — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy of v2.3.1. Observed error rate was 18% with healthy=false reported by the service status API.

Action taken: Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release previously healthy in production (deployment history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc in staging also unhealthy). Post-rollback verification confirms all three regions on v2.3.0 with healthy=true and error rate reduced to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so any future re-deploy of it requires change-manager approval. The v2.3.1-rc staging signal was also unhealthy, suggesting the defect was present before the production rollout. Follow-up recommended: root-cause analysis on the v2.3.1 change set before re-attempting release.

The incident was in fact created (INC-0001) — the timeout was on the response only, so I did not retry and avoided a duplicate page.

## Summary

**Diagnosis:** `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), reporting `healthy: false` with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, then v2.3.1 unhealthy — and notably the staging release v2.3.1-rc also shows unhealthy.

**Action taken:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all production regions. Verified post-rollback: all three regions on v2.3.0, `healthy: true`, error rate down from 18% → 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001**, SEV2, for checkout-api, documenting the failure, the rollback, and post-rollback verification.

Two notes worth acting on:
- v2.3.1 has **never been healthy in production**, so any future attempt to deploy it requires change-manager approval per policy.
- The unhealthy v2.3.1-rc in staging indicates the defect predates the production rollout — worth an RCA on the v2.3.1 change set, and ideally a stricter staging gate given it passed into production despite the staging signal.
